title: camera-comfyUI: 3D Camera Projection Nodes for ComfyUI
summary: A specialized suite of custom nodes for ComfyUI that enables advanced 3D-aware image transformations and VR content creation using depth-to-point cloud pipelines. It facilitates seamless reprojection between pinhole, fisheye, and equirectangular camera models for complex video synthesis workflows.
research_notes: Key dependencies include Open3D and FFmpeg; the tool is particularly optimized for iterative outpainting into full-sphere VR environments.

evolution.summary: The project has evolved from basic projection tools into a comprehensive pipeline for 3D-aware outpainting and novel view synthesis. Recent updates include integration with Depth Anything V3, support for generative video models like Wan2.1 and LTX-2.3, and a new Open3D-based GUI for interactive camera trajectory recording.
